name: gcp.m.upbound.io/v1beta1.ClusterProviderConfig

spec.description: A ProviderConfigSpec defines the desired state of a ProviderConfig.

credentials.description: Credentials required to authenticate to this provider.

env.description:
Env is a reference to an environment variable that contains credentials
that must be used to connect to the provider.

name.description: Name is the name of an environment variable.

fs.description:
Fs is a reference to a filesystem location that contains credentials that
must be used to connect to the provider.

impersonateServiceAccount.description: Use GCP service account impersonation for authentication.

secretRef.description:
A SecretRef is a reference to a secret key that contains the credentials
that must be used to connect to the provider.

upbound.description:
Upbound defines the options for authenticating using Upbound as an
identity provider.

federation.description: Federation is the configuration for federated identity.

providerID.description:
ProviderID is the fully-qualified identifier for the identity provider on
GCP. The format is
`projects/<project-id>/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/<identity-pool>/providers/<identity-provider>`.

serviceAccount.description: ServiceAccount is the email address for the attached service account.

projectID.description: ProjectID is the project name (not numerical ID) of this GCP ProviderConfig.

status.description: A ProviderConfigStatus reflects the observed state of a ProviderConfig.

items.description: A Condition that may apply to a resource.

lastTransitionTime.description:
LastTransitionTime is the last time this condition transitioned from one
status to another.

message.description:
A Message containing details about this condition's last transition from
one status to another, if any.

observedGeneration.description:
ObservedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description: A Reason for this condition's last transition from one status to another.

status.description: Status of this condition; is it currently True, False, or Unknown?

type.description:
Type of this condition. At most one of each condition type may apply to
a resource at any point in time.

title: Cluster Provider Config
description: A ClusterProviderConfig configures a GCP provider.
